news.Title: 【Follow法人】台股站上4萬8誰在買？外資再砸373億元 連5買破2022億元
news.Content:
台股今（23）日終場首度攻破4萬8千點大關，收在48,157點，創下收盤歷史新高。三大法人今日合計買超389.21億元，外資今日也延續買超態勢，今日再砸373.13億元，呈連五買，累計買超2022.92億元。

外資連五買 今日再加碼373億元

根據證交所公布籌碼動向，三大法人今日合計買超389.21億元。其中，外資也同步買超373.13億元，呈連5買，累計買超2022.92億元。

投信則是延續賣超，投信今日合計賣超42.16億元，呈連2賣。自營商則持續買超58.24億元，其中自行買賣買超22.25億元，避險操作買超35.99億元。

台股今日再度收漲，加權指數終場收在48,157點，上漲357點，首度攻破4萬8千點大關，創下收盤歷史新高。權王台積電（2330）終場收在2,500元，上漲40元。

湯暖萱／財經特派記者，主跑主計處、營建、百貨紡織等

news.Title: 節前DRAM雙雄、醫療股撐盤，KOSPI週三續漲0.9%至十週新高
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】美股那指和那指100上日連袂破頂，帶動韓國記憶體股延續漲勢。首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)週三開高走低，終場上漲63.01點或0.90%，收在7,080.92點，為7月15日以來約十週新高。韓股開盤急漲1.9%，以全日最高7,153.99點開出，其後漲勢逐級而下，盤中一度下探7,014.98點、跌落平盤，收盤前重新站穩漲勢。韓股週四、週五因中秋節休市，連同週末形成四天連休。

三星電子與SK海力士分別收漲3.25%及1.2%，漲幅皆超越大盤，帶動電子類股上漲1.95%，漲幅在十九大類股中排名第二，僅次於上漲3.36%的醫療與精密設備類股。

盤面分化明顯，另有十五大類股收跌；營建類股重挫5.66%，為最大賣壓中心，現代建設大跌7.77%，在三十檔大型股組成的KTOP30淪為最大輸家，機械股重挫3.22%為第二大賣壓中心。

news.Title: Own Realty Income By Sept. 30 to Qualify for Its Oct. 15 Dividend. Here's How Many Shares You'd Need for $1,251 in Yearly Dividends.
news.Content:
Realty Income Corp. (NYSE: O) is one of the best-known real estate investment trusts (REITs) around.

Like most REITs, it receives favorable tax treatment in exchange for paying out most of its operating income as dividends to its shareholders. That's why REITs have significant yields. Realty Income is currently yielding 5.2% on a trailing-12-month basis.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Realty Income's next monthly dividend payment arrives Oct. 15. But in order to get that payment, you'd need to own shares by the "ex-dividend date" of Sept. 30.

Here's how many shares you'd need to own to get $1,251 in annual dividends from Realty Income.

Why try for $1,251

Currently, the median income for full-time workers in the U.S. is about $1,251 per week. So it's a good benchmark to use for those who are thinking about replacing their wages with dividend income in retirement.

As of this writing, shares of Realty Income cost about $57 each, and the annual dividend -- which has increased every quarter for 115 consecutive quarters ( more than 28 years ) -- is $3.25 per share.

So in order to get $1,251 per year in dividends, you'd need 385 shares of Realty Income, which would currently cost you about $21,945.

That probably sounds like a big investment for just a week's worth of money, but remember, after that initial outlay of cash, you'll get $1,251 in the first year, and each year thereafter, you're likely to get more as the company continues to increase its dividend over time.

For example, if you'd bought 385 shares of Realty Income in 2015, it would have cost you about $19,878. But since then, you would have already made $12,298.44 in dividends: 61.9% of your initial investment!

That said, because Realty Income offers a monthly dividend payment, there's no rush to jump in all at once if you don't have the money available. There's always a new dividend payment just around the corner.

news.Title: 〈台股盤後〉台積電、鴻海領漲成功站上4萬8 漲357點收48157點
news.Content:
台積電及鴻海今(23)日走揚，加上台泥成功拓展東歐市場走揚，帶動台股大盤今天早盤一度漲逾500點，最高漲至48341.56點，雖然隨後漲幅收斂，終場仍漲357.12點或0.75%，收48157.29點，成功站上4萬8，不過成交量縮至8559.53億元。

觀察電子權值股表現，今天僅有台積電(2330-TW)與鴻海(2317-TW)有所表現，台積電漲40元或1.63%，收2500元，鴻海也漲逾1%，聯發科(2454-TW)則小漲0.1%。台達電(2308-TW)、聯電(2303-TW)及日月光(3711-TW)皆收平盤，廣達(2382-TW)則小跌0.15%。

台泥(1101-TW)今日宣布，擬以不超過7.5億歐元(約新台幣212億元)，收購烏克蘭水泥建材公司IFCEM等公司的100%股權，成功將歐洲水泥版圖進一步拓展至東歐市場，激勵台泥今天漲逾4%，同步帶動亞泥(1102-TW)漲逾1%，嘉泥(1103-TW)、環泥(1103-TW)也都小漲表態。

功率元件族群受惠漲價潮，表現亮眼，強茂(2481-TW)、德微(3675-TW)亮燈漲停。昨(22)日召開法說會的嘉晶(3016-TW)也指出，需求能見度看至2028年，激勵嘉晶今天漲停鎖住145.5元，漢磊(3707-TW)也漲逾1%。

生技族群今天同樣有表現，台新藥(6838-TW)漲停鎖住26.25元，禾榮科(7799-TW)漲逾4%，台康生技(6589-TW)、保瑞(6472-TW)漲逾3%，另外，承業醫(4164-TW)、心誠鎂(6934-TW)、全福(6885-TW)、懷特(4108-TW)及藥華藥(6446-TW)皆有1至2%漲幅。

news.Title: If the Market Crashes, This Is the 1 Space Stock I Can't Wait to Buy
news.Content:
If the stock market crashes, one of the first stocks I'll be watching is Rocket Lab (NASDAQ: RKLB). Not because I expect Rocket Lab to hold up particularly well during a crash. Quite the opposite, actually.

You see, high-growth stocks with ambitious expectations can get crushed when investors start dumping risk. And Rocket Lab has reached a valuation where plenty of future growth is already baked into the stock. It's already valued at nearly $40 billion, or roughly 50 times trailing sales, meaning investors are paying a hefty premium for growth that has yet to materialize. But underneath that valuation is a space company that is becoming increasingly difficult to ignore.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Rocket Lab generated a record $234 million in second-quarter revenue, up 62% year over year. Its backlog reached another record at $2.36 billion, up 137%. The company also said it had secured more than $437 million in new launch contracts during the quarter and shortly afterward. That's a very different business from the speculative space start-up Rocket Lab was just a few years ago.

More than rockets

Rocket Lab is probably best known for Electron, its small-launch rocket. Electron has now completed 96 missions, including three launches in September alone. But launch is only part of the business.

Rocket Lab builds satellites, solar cells, flight software, separation systems, and other spacecraft components. It's increasingly positioning itself as an end-to-end space company capable of building the satellite, launching it, and supporting the overall mission. And government contracts are becoming a bigger part of that opportunity.

In July, Rocket Lab landed a $266 million U.S. Space Force contract covering 12 suborbital launches, with options for six more. It was also awarded a $397 million contract to build and launch spacecraft for the Space Force's Space-Based Airborne Moving Target Indicator program.

Then there's Neutron. This is Rocket Lab's larger reusable rocket that's designed to compete for constellation deployments, national-security missions, and other launches that Electron simply can't handle. The company already has customers lined up, including a confidential customer that booked five Neutron missions as part of Rocket Lab's largest launch agreement at the time.

Story Continues

To be sure, Neutron still carries significant execution risk. Delays, cost overruns, or launch failures could quickly change the investment thesis. Rocket Lab also remains unprofitable. So this isn't some low-risk blue chip stock disguised as a space company. But the balance sheet gives Rocket Lab room to keep investing. As of June 30, it held roughly $2.1 billion in cash and cash equivalents, plus another $258 million in marketable securities.

That combination of rapidly growing revenue, billions in backlog, government contracts, a proven launch business, and Neutron's potential is why Rocket Lab would be near the top of my shopping list during a market crash.

Don't get me wrong. I wouldn't be hoping the business stumbles. In fact, I'm quite bullish on this one. But if the market does crash, I'll be eagerly awaiting an opportunity to buy a few shares at a massive discount.

news.Title: 漲勢比聯發科更猛！外資點名台股這檔黑馬「目標價1.2萬」：獲利可望翻8倍
news.Content:
台股多頭行情持續，今（23）日早盤延續強勢，加權指數開高後漲幅一度擴大至超過500點。示意圖。（資料照，中央社）

台股多頭行情持續，聯發科日前站上5000元讓市場驚豔，而AIASIC浪潮下，另一檔IC設計股創意漲勢更猛，22日強攻漲停8375元、刷新歷史天價，今早盤漲至8520元創高後回到平盤之上。外資報告首度將創意納入研究範圍，直接喊出12000元目標價。法人預估未來3年創意的EPS可望翻8倍，成為AIASIC浪潮中，最吸睛的高價股之一。

台股22日多頭氣勢震撼全場，隨著大盤強勢衝上4萬8大關，高價IC設計族群人氣沸騰，聯發科一度衝上5480元再創歷史天價，但外資焦點更狂推IP矽智財龍頭創意。受惠於AIASIC（特殊應用積體電路）需求急遽升溫，北美大型雲端服務供應商（CSP）客戶的新一代AIASIC專案持續穩健推進，相關產品預計今年底至明年初步入量產階段。加上創意取得母公司台積電明年的先進製程產能全力支援，讓法人機構對其營運動能寄予厚望，推升創意成為ASIC族群中股價最高、最具代表性的指標股。

台積電「親兒子」漲勢驚人　外資喊創意目標價1.2萬

在基本面方面，創意受惠AIASIC專案出貨大幅放量，8月合併營收再創歷史新高，已連續3個月刷新單月歷史紀錄。隨著全球AI算力需求逐步由「模型訓練」延伸至「推論端」，ASIC憑藉能效比優勢深受大廠青睞。創意近年也將服務範疇從傳統晶片設計，進一步延伸至CoWoS封裝、實體設計及系統整合，並積極卡位2奈米與3奈米先進製程專案，全面強化其在AI加速器領域的關鍵競爭力。

外資機構ALETHEIACAPITAL出具的最新報告指出，代理型AI（AgenticAI）工作負載快速普及，加上運算成本居高不下，促使CSP廠與AI實驗室加速推動自研ASIC計畫，創意將是最大受惠者，給予「買進」評等，目標價上看1萬2000元。

外資指出，創意不僅提供先進封裝IP組合，更結合TURNKEY（委託設計轉量產）服務，並與台積電設計技術平台（DTP）建立無可比擬的合作關係，服務範疇正從Google、微軟的CPU延伸至客製化ASIC。外資預估創意明年3、5奈米晶圓配額將成長5倍，營收可望跳升4倍，且2028年前EPS有望暴衝8倍，因而給予遠高於市場共識近2倍的極致估值。

news.Title: 【盤後焦點】台股節前量縮震盪上漲357點　連兩日創收盤新高
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中台北2026年9月23日電）台股今天開高震盪重登48000點關卡，水泥和電子股走勢相對強勢，終場上漲357.12點，收在48157.29點，再創台股收盤歷史新高，成交值新台幣8559.53億元。

台泥 (1101) 臨時董事會通過授權旗下荷蘭子公司，以不超過7.5億歐元企業價值，推進收購烏克蘭第2大水泥建材公司IFCEM等公司100%股權，進一步布局東歐市場。台泥今天股價表現強勁，收在25.65元，上漲4.48%，推升水泥類股指數上漲2.84%。

其餘傳統產業股漲跌互見，橡膠類股指數上漲0.99%，塑膠、玻璃和機電類股指數下挫逾1%，營建類股指數下跌2.41%，表現相對疲弱。

電子股方面，台積電 (2330) 今天收在2500元，上漲40元，市值回升至64.83兆元，貢獻大盤約317點。其餘電子權值股漲跌互見，鴻海 (2317) 上漲1.19%，台光電 (2383) 、欣興 (3037) 同步上漲逾3%，整體電子類股指數上漲1.06%。

高價股方面，千金股表現不同調，股王信驊 (5274) 下跌625元，收在20280元，股后川湖 (2059) 下跌280元，收在12390元；健策 (3653) 強攻漲停，達到6410元，台股維持49千金。

資深分析師劉坤錫表示，隨著長假即將來臨，台股今天指數最高未能強勢挑戰22日盤中創下的48601.53點歷史最高點，短期可能維持震盪走勢。（編輯：張良知）

news.Title: 站穩48K！台股收盤漲357點　台積電收2500元
news.Content:
台股今（23）日開盤上漲94.6點，以47894.77點開出，隨後在台積電股價上揚帶動下走高，一度上漲1541.39點，攻上48341.56點，不過因中秋連假將至，量能不足，漲勢收斂，終場上漲357.12點，以48157.29點作收，成交量8559.53億元。

權值股方面，台積電（2330）上漲40元，收2500元，漲幅1.63%；鴻海（2317）上漲3元，收256元，漲幅1.19%；廣達（2382）下跌0.50元，收341.5元，跌幅0.15%；台達電（2308）持平，收1900元；聯發科（2454）上漲5元，收5185元，漲幅0.10%；台光電（2383）上漲160元，收5020元，漲幅3.29%。

news.Title: 台股漲357點！台積電站回2500元 「這PCB」收漲停
news.Content:
台股今（23）日開高震盪，上漲357點，收48157點，漲幅0.75%，成交量來到8500億；櫃買指數則由紅翻黑，下跌1.41點，收413.76點，跌幅0.34%。

權值股部分，台積電站回2500元關卡，上漲40元，漲幅1.63%，聯發科來到5185元，上漲5元，漲幅0.1%，鴻海來到256元，上漲1.19%。

日前受宏碁董事長陳俊聖一句「記憶體沒想像中缺」、以及中國DRAM龍頭長鑫科技宣布，第5代G5技術正式進入量產等「鬼故事」影響的記憶體族群，今日則集體上漲，華邦電來到172.5元，上漲0.88%，南亞科來到515元，上漲3.62%，力積電來到73.1元，上漲1.37%，群聯、旺宏也有1.37%、0.85%的漲幅。

PCB族群也有零星火種，金像電收漲停來到1140元，台光電、欣興、南電上漲逾3%，台耀、金居也有逾1%的漲幅。

news.Title: 台積電站上2500元，指數創收盤新高
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃俊超】美股道瓊9/22下跌0.36%、S&P500幾乎平盤、Nasdaq上漲0.45%、費城半導體上漲2.06%。德國股市上漲0.02%、法國股市上漲0.2%。布蘭特原油與西德州原油都已回跌至100美元之下，Nasdaq再創歷史新高，川習會即將舉辦。日經指數休市一天，近期反彈回到20日均線附近，仍維持在60日與120日均線之間，有機會隨國際股市向上挑戰，韓國綜合指數在120日均線附近，均線逐漸全面朝向轉為上彎。中國上證指數在短中期均線與長期均線之間，依舊處在區間整理格局，香港恆生指數拉回至60日均線下，均線持續趨於糾結。美元指數100~101，新台幣31.5~32，日圓近日回貶至157.5附近。

加權指數開高震盪，終場上漲357.12點、0.75%，收在48157.29點，成交量為8559.53億元，盤中收盤新高，縱然成交量較巔峰少了一半，不過資金持續且有效率集中在權值股，帶動加權指數持穩強勢，短中期均線趨於糾結，不過已全面轉為上彎，日KD指標交叉向上後延伸，日MACD指標紅色柱狀體增加，仍屬有利多方。若國際總體經濟與股市沒有太大變化，則台股可望延續盤堅向上走勢，不過若成交量能持續偏低，震盪恐將會是常態。需觀察川習會效應，國際股市與長假前的籌碼變化。

櫃檯指數開高後震盪走低，終場下跌1.41點、0.34%，收在413.76點，成交量為2491.1億元，收盤指數仍在所有均線之上，短中期均線仍屬糾結，不過除60日均線外皆已轉為上彎，日KD指標交叉向上後延伸、開口收斂，日MACD指標紅色柱狀體略增。

台積電(2330)漲1.63%，收盤回到2500元，聯發科(2454)漲0.1%，股價持穩強勢，台達電(2308)平盤、鴻海(2317)漲1.19%、日月光投控(3711)平盤，健策(3653)與金像電(2368)攻上漲停板，貿聯-KY(3665)、南電(8046)、南亞科(2408)、欣興(3037)與台光電(2383)漲幅超過3%，金融股攻勢暫歇，傳產股則各自表述。

news.Title: 聯茂苦主年度最衰？驚爆3億違約交割後漲回　內行揭台股T+2制度恐怖之處：不只要賠錢
news.Content:
台股近日爆出今年最大 違約交割 事件。示意圖，與新聞個案無關。（資料照，中央社）

台股22日受到美股科技股走強帶動，盤中最高來到48601.53點，創下盤中歷史新高，雖最終賣壓出現，指數漲幅快速收斂，終場仍上漲81.33點，收在47800.17點，同樣創下收盤新高。另外，引發投資人討論的是，銅箔基板大廠聯茂（6213）日前爆出約3.19億元違約交割，創下今年上市公司單次違約交割金額最高紀錄。對此，「股海老牛」在財經臉書粉專中提醒，投資人面對高波動個股時，除注意股價漲跌，也要留意資金是否足以支應交割，「行情常常不照劇本走」，一旦沒有預留資金空間，可能從投資獲利變成交割危機。

聯茂為何出現3.19億元違約交割？

9月17日，台股受到美國聯準會升息消息影響，開盤後一度大漲逾千點，終場上漲439.10點、收46288點，聯茂則逆勢下跌，開高後一路下殺，最後以495元跌停作收，單日下跌55元。而後證交所於21日公告，券商北城通報聯茂發生約3.19億元鉅額違約交割，成為今年以來上市公司單次最高金額，也是今年第12起上市公司鉅額違約交割事件。盤點聯茂後續表現，22日已回到543元、較495元的跌停價高出48元，當天上漲1元、漲幅0.18%，成交量達2萬822張。

台股違約交割是什麼？不用先掏錢？

股海老牛指出，當聯茂爆出#聯茂 昨天爆出3.19億元事件後，他的第一個念頭是「到底誰那麼衰」，因為聯茂後來有漲回來。他解釋，台股採「T+2制度」，也就是今天買後才付錢，因此有人會把這兩天當成免費的借款期，重壓後想等漲了再賣掉，根本不用真的掏出錢。但此次，17日大盤漲了439點，聯茂卻跌停鎖在495元，很多人錢還沒賺到，先跌出一個補不回來的洞。

違約交割下場會怎樣？最慘不只是賠錢

股海老牛提醒，違約的代價不只是賠錢那麼簡單，券商雖會先代墊後才追討，但信用紀錄會留下污點，集保帳戶可能被限制，最嚴重的，恐怕還會有法律責任，因此不只是「沒賺到」的問題，而是以後連進場的資格都喪失了。他進一步說，交割違約這類事情的根源，通常是把「兩天後付得出來的錢」和「兩天後想賺到的錢」搞混了，因為行情不一定會照劇本走，「沒餘裕的人，看錯一次就得被抬出場！」

news.Title: 台積電高人氣早盤衝破2500元 台股市值躍居全球第四大
news.Content:
台股繼22日以4萬8601點創盤中新高後，雖遭獲利調節，終場漲幅收斂收在4萬7800點亦寫下收盤新高紀錄，指數23日仍呈上漲趨勢，台積電挾高人氣帶頭衝，最高衝破2500元大關來到2505元，早盤指數最高來到4萬8341點；根據MarketCapWatch網站所公布之最新全球主要股市市值排名，台股市值已躍居全球第四大。

由於類股輪動速度快，投資人想持續隨上台股成長行情，投信建議，有專業經理人操盤，機動調整持股的主動市值ETF是最為便利的工具，既享大型龍頭股的底氣，也能把握重點趨勢／題材股的成長行情。

群益投信主動式台股ETF研究團隊表示，近年來台股市值前50大跟隨產業發展與當時市況而持續洗牌，回顧2020-2022年因新冠疫情影響而令面板、載板、航運類股備受市場關注，爾後在AI科技於全球掀起浪潮下，2023至2024年AI基建題材火熱，也讓伺服器、ASIC、散熱等重點個股市值躍進，進入2025年後至今，隨AI需求擴散，PCB、記憶體、測試成為資金布局重點，其2025年更是近十年市值前50大企業替換高峰。

群益投信進一步指出，正因主流產業更替，建議投資人可透過主動市值ETF來掌握，以跟隨市場結構動態調整，網羅當代核心企業，掌握台股成長和新動能。

台新投信臺灣中小主動式ETF經理人沈建宏指出，今年市場聚焦權值股，投資人只要掌握AI趨勢重壓權值股就對了，但時序來到2027年，投資人選股會更困難， 因為台股獲利增速換檔、供應鏈分化，超額報酬核心將由「題材上漲」走向「獲利兌現與企業差異」，將造就台股主動選股新浪潮，ETF資金從大型權值股漸往較小股本靠攏，中小股本公司更有表現空間，因此，將發行聚焦中小股本的主動式台股ETF。

展望中秋節後台股表現，主動群益核心50 (00415A)經理人許育誌表示，隨中東局勢、各國央行動向等不確定性逐一解除，AI科技基本面強勁與第四季電子消費旺季等利多支持下，有助吸引資金回流布局市值龍頭股與重點AI趨勢股，後市表現值得關注，包括AI伺服器、PCB／ABF、測試介面、半導體設備、電源與散熱等類股表現值得留意。

news.Title: Elon Musk Is Going All In on Nvidia, but Are These Two Chip Stocks Better Buys?
news.Content:
Elon Musk made waves when he announced that Space Exploration Technologies would exclusively use Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) chips going forward. It was a big coup for the graphics processing unit (GPU) maker and is sure to bring in hundreds of billions of dollars in revenue in the coming years.

However, Nvidia is not the only artificial intelligence (AI) semiconductor stock in town, and Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ: AMD) and Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) could actually be the better investments. Here's why.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Training vs. inference

Nvidia made its mark in AI model training, and there is little doubt it will remain the leader in this space. When the company developed its CUDA software platform to program its GPUs, it smartly gave the software away for free and seeded it in places doing early work on AI.

The result was a generation of developers trained on its software, with most foundational AI code written using its software and optimized for its chips. This moat in training still holds strong today.

While the AI training segment remains strong, inference is growing faster and is projected to become a much larger market in the coming years. According to Bloomberg Intelligence, the inference market is projected to grow at a 32% compound annual growth rate until 2032, reaching $1.3 trillion, which would be about double the $658 billion it expects the AI training segment to reach over the same time period.

This is important because inference is less technically demanding than training, and Nvidia's CUDA moat is not nearly as wide. Inference is also less about raw compute power and more about quick access to memory; since inference is an ongoing cost, cost-per-inference becomes a very important factor.

AMD and Broadcom: Big inference opportunities ahead

This opens the door for both AMD and Broadcom to become major players in the inference market. AMD's GPUs are much cheaper than Nvidia's, and it has nicely improved its ROCm software platform over the past few years. Meanwhile, its chiplet design can be packaged with more high bandwidth memory (HBM), making its GPUs well-suited for inference.

It's also made a lot of moves in memory, including its acquisitions of the memory optimization company MEXT and the inference chip designer Taalas. In addition, its new Veral chips for edge computing incorporate on-chip SRAM (static random-access memory) to reduce reliance on off-chip memory during inference. Finally, it has also partnered with Cerebras for a high-end inference offering, where Cerebras' ultra-fast but expensive chips handle the decode phase of inference while its GPUs handle the pre-fill phase, helping it compete directly against Nvidia following its deal with Groq.

Story Continues

AMD already has two $100 billion multiyear deals in place with OpenAI and Meta Platforms , and it recently announced that Anthropic and Microsoft are also GPU customers. On top of that, it is a leader in server central processing units (CPUs), a market it sees growing to $220 billion in the coming years due to the rise of agentic AI.

Broadcom is also set to become a big player in the inference market. The company is a leader in ASICs (application-specific integrated circuits), which are custom chips hardwired to perform certain tasks. While they are less flexible than GPUs, they are high-performance and use less power than general-purpose GPUs, making them particularly attractive for reducing inference costs.

Instead of making its own AI chips, Broadcom helps customers turn their designs into physical AI chips that can be manufactured at scale. It helped Alphabet co-design its highly regarded Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), which are set to be its biggest growth driver, both internally and by selling these chips to Anthropic. Broadcom has also helped OpenAI and Meta Platforms design their own custom chips.

As these programs ramp up, it sees its AI revenue doubling next fiscal year to $115 billion, then doubling again to $230 billion in fiscal 2028.

Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom all have strong growth ahead from the AI infrastructure build-out, but AMD and Broadcom could be set to outperform their larger rival given their positions in the inference market and growth off of a smaller base. That makes them the better AI stocks to buy, despite Musk's endorsement.

news.Title: 〈滙豐經濟展望〉估Fed 12月再升息1碼 AI助攻台灣企業獲利、經濟成長動能強
news.Content:
滙豐銀行今(23)日舉行2026年第四季投資展望線上記者會，滙豐私人銀行及財富管理北亞首席投資總監何偉華指出，儘管過去數月半導體股價波動、美國利率變動及地緣政治等因素交織，但全球經濟與企業盈利仍優於市場預期。其中，台灣將繼續受惠於 AI 數據中心發展，雖下半年基期較高，未來的經濟與企業盈利成長前景依然樂觀，因此維持對全球股票的偏高配置，固定收益也具顯著機遇。滙豐預估美國聯準會 12 月將再升息 1 碼，2027 年則按兵不動。

滙豐私人銀行表示，全球主要經濟體的經濟驚喜指數多呈現正向，且製造業受惠於 AI 快速發展，對資料中心與半導體投資強勁，加上全球油價與大宗商品價格支撐，帶動整體製造業穩定成長。在通膨與利率方面，雖然美國通膨壓力仍存，使得美國聯準會於9月採取升息行動，但通膨數據仍在可控預期內，金融市場流動性對通膨產生的壓力相對穩定。

針對市場高度關注的美國利率政策，何偉華進一步指出，滙豐預估Fed在12月仍有再升息1碼(25個基點)的可能性，主要由於通膨回落至2%目標水平仍需時間，預計要到2028年，加上美國經濟增長強勁。

不過何偉華認為，升息對股市估值影響有限，且預測明年Fed將維持利率不動。在匯市方面，受鷹派政策、能源自給優勢及選後資金回流支撐，美元指數短線仍看升；日元在政府干預與利差因素抵銷下將呈區間震盪；離岸人民幣則受惠於中國強勁出口貿易順差與人民幣國際化政策推動，中長期將呈現溫和升值走勢。

在資產配置策略上，滙豐維持對全球股市「加碼」的立場。何偉華分析，全球約有 70% 的企業盈利預測獲得上調，市場盈利增長動力極強。針對市場關注的科技股估值問題，何偉華認為，經過第二季的股價修正後，美股科技股的估值已回落至合理水平，與非科技股差異不大，且科技業盈利增長顯著，因此「不需過度擔憂科技股存在泡沫」。

針對即將到來的11月美國期中選舉，滙豐研究過去 24 次期中選舉歷史數據顯示，雖然選前股市易受訊息面影響而波動，但在選後 12 個月內，有 22 次股市皆呈現上揚走勢。滙豐預期在不確定性消除後，市場將重新回歸基本面與合理估值，美股表現依舊看好。

就區域市場而言，滙豐看好美國、日本，以及包含台灣、南韓在內的北亞市場。針對債券與另類資產，滙豐指出，目前實質利率已處於具吸引力的偏高水平，建議投資人可持有所屬優質公司債至到期；同時搭配對沖基金、私募市場及黃金等資產，以提升多元投資組合的抗震韌性。

news.Title: “The New Clippy”: Benioff Uses Salesforce’s Biggest Product Launch in Years to Challenge Microsoft
news.Content:
Marc Benioff is never one to pass up a chance to take a jab at Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT ), and Dreamforce 2026 was no different. The Salesforce CEO used the company's flagship annual conference in San Francisco to announce AIforce, the biggest product launch Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE: CRM ) has made in years, and to once again refer to Microsoft's Copilot as "the new Clippy," doubling down on a dig he made two years ago.

What AIforce Actually Does

Salesforce is positioning AIforce as an open, provider-agnostic layer rather than a single proprietary assistant. It's intended to work across multiple AI systems, including Anthropic's Claude, via a specific integration called Claudeforce, which Salesforce claims guarantees zero data retention by the model provider, as well as ChatGPT, Slack, and other environments. Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE:CRM) made the announcement alongside an additional strategic marker: a fiscal 2030 revenue target of $63 billion, which management reiterated at Dreamforce.

A Rivalry That Goes Back To 2024

Benioff portrayed AIforce as the solution to what he calls the "Fantasyland" problem, arguing that competing AI solutions, including Copilot, lack the dependable, controlled business-data layer required to consistently run enterprise operations. It's a continuation of a public feud that's been going on since at least Dreamforce 2024, when Benioff first compared Copilot to Clippy, Microsoft's widely mocked, uninvited desktop assistant from the late 1990s, saying, "We all know now that Microsoft Copilot is basically the new Microsoft Clippy, that customers have not gotten value from it." He's returned to that theme several times since, including at Davos, in an October 2024 written critique saying that Microsoft "lacks the data, metadata, and enterprise security models to create real corporate intelligence," and on a podcast where he labeled Copilot a "tremendous disservice" to the AI sector.

Favorable Analyst Response

Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE:CRM) shares closed at $255.65 on September 15, after a nearly 34% rally in the previous month following a rough start to 2026 that saw the stock tumble as much as 37%. That momentum was fueled by Salesforce's most recent quarterly results, which featured $11.35 billion in revenue, exceeding Wall Street's projections on both the top and bottom lines. Analyst reaction to the Dreamforce announcements was also favorable, with Stifel raising its price target for Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE:CRM) to $300 from $275 while reaffirming a Buy rating, citing six distinct revenue channels laid out by the company for monetizing its new AI stack, including additional core licenses, premium SKU upgrades, Agentforce spending, Data 360, Agent Fabric and Guardian, and APIs, MCPs and related infrastructure.

Story Continues

Institutional Positioning

Institutional posture shifted in similar directions for the two competitors. Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE:CRM) saw hedge fund ownership fall slightly, from 101 in the first quarter to 99 in the second. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) experienced a greater fall, from 282 funds to 273, though both declines predate the Dreamforce event and are more likely to reflect broader software-sector positioning moves than a direct read on this contest.

How AIforce Takes On Copilot

Salesforce's pitch for AIforce as an open layer that brings Salesforce data, permissions and business logic into Claude, ChatGPT and other AI interfaces could still be an important competitive distinction, particularly for companies that want to use Salesforce context across multiple AI environments. The emphasis on regulated data access and zero data retention in Claudeforce directly addresses enterprise trust problems, which have hampered AI adoption elsewhere.

Conference Hype, Unclear Pricing, and Microsoft's Distribution Juggernaut

However, Salesforce's stock has a documented history of rallying on analyst upgrades and conference announcements before reversing those gains, as seen with earlier JPMorgan and Citi buy calls in 2026, and pricing and adoption uncertainty around Agentforce remain unanswered questions even as new products pile on top of it. Microsoft's competition is also far from theoretical, considering Copilot's distribution advantage via Office and Dynamics 365.

Insider Monkey's Bottom Line

Investors should keep an eye on whether this round of enthusiasm lasts longer than previous Dreamforce-fueled surges, with confirmation likely to come from the next quarterly report, which will show whether Agentforce and now AIforce adoption numbers are translating into the kind of Data and AI revenue growth analysts are projecting with their newly set $300 price targets. Given the remaining uncertainty around how quickly Salesforce can convert AI adoption into meaningful revenue, the more reliable signal for investors will be concrete adoption and revenue-conversion data in upcoming earnings, rather than the announcement itself or the pre-Dreamforce rally that followed Salesforce's latest earnings report.

While we acknowledge the potential of CRM as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: 聯發科率先突破創高，台股量能回升聚焦半導體設備、耗材與光通
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃啟乙】台股週二突破創新高後，週三指數持續維持強勢，成交量也緩步向1兆元靠攏，顯示市場動能持續增溫。其中，聯發科(2454)率先突破並創下新高，成為近期拉動指數向上突破的重要力量之一。　　展望後續，半導體產業持續擴充，台積電(2330)也不斷推進先進製程，相關設備與耗材需求可望同步受到帶動，盤面上設備、耗材族群近期也持續出現強攻表現。

其中，崇越(5434)股價維持盤堅走勢；探針卡領域則可留意景美(7899)，股價自低檔型態逐步回升，已有展開新一輪行情的跡象。此外，光通訊、矽光子等產業近期也展現向上發展動能，若市場資金持續輪動，相關族群可望成為台股後續攻堅的重要陣容。

news.Title: 滙豐估美聯準會12月再升息 明年利率不變
news.Content:
美國 聯準會 (Fed)的利率政策，一直是各國央行的主要參考指引。聯準會在睽違3年後，在9月重新啟動升息。接下來動向，也引發市場關注。滙豐銀行今天(23日)舉行2026年第四季投資展望，認為以美國經濟成長和通膨預期來看，預估聯準會12月會再升息1碼，明年利率則會保持不變。

針對市場高度關切聯準會利率決策，滙豐私人銀行及財富管理北亞首席投資總監 何偉華 表示，雖然美國基準利率已來到相對高檔，但美國核心通膨表現依然頑強，根據最新總體經濟模型推估，美國核心通膨可能要一路延續至2028年，才有機會實質降至聯準會設定的2%政策目標。

何偉華也指出，聯準會在9月的官方報告中，已同步調高今年與明年的美國經濟成長率(GDP)預測。他分析，在「經濟基本面出乎意料強勁」與「通膨高檔」的雙重背景下，聯準會有相當大的壓力必須透過升息來抑制經濟過熱。因此，12月再加碼升息1碼幾乎已成定局。

何偉華也進一步表示，若今年年底前聯準會升息2碼，屆時基準利率將推升至4%，比目前的通膨率還要高，明年聯準會就會「按兵不動」，持續觀察在高利率下的美國國內通膨情勢。何偉華說：『(原音)最主要原因就是在能源方面，我們剛才說對美國的通膨影響比較小。第二就是美國升息兩碼之後，它的利率也明顯比通膨高，所以利率的水平對通膨控制也要一定的力度。』

若聯準會在今年兩度升息，是否會對股債市帶來重新估值的風險？何偉華認為，美國企業目前的盈利增長預期依然維持在15%至20%的高水準，尤其在AI算力與資料中心的基礎建設資本支出持續擴大下，科技股的基本面依舊強韌。目前美股本益比約在18至19倍，屬於過去5年的歷史合理區間，因此年底若再升息1碼，對美股整體估值的實質衝擊相當有限。 (編輯:柳向華)

news.Title: 費半6連紅、Meta神助攻！大戶抱1億爽賺2,200萬「大盤4萬8、散戶手上剩1萬8？」買到這些股票恐淪長假前最慘替死鬼
news.Content:
台股多頭氣勢如虹！受到美股科技股續創新高、Meta全新AI助理爆紅，以及台灣本土基本面外銷訂單連19紅等三大核心利多點火，台股今（23）日開盤後展現強勁漲勢。大盤在電子權值股與科技晶片股群起攻之下，盤中一度狂飆逾500點，強勢叩關48,000點歷史整數大關，再度刷新台股新紀錄。然而，盤面呈現極端的兩極化走勢，也引發市場法人與網路社群的激烈辯論。

國際多頭三重奏 費半六連紅奠定外資買盤

從國際盤勢來看，與台股連動性極高的費城半導體指數昨日上漲2.06％，已寫下連續六個交易日收紅的強勢紀錄。由於美國債券殖利率止穩，加上中東地緣政治傳出荷莫茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz）可能開放的消息，國際油價進一步跌破百元大關，大幅舒緩市場對通膨的擔憂，吸引全球資金持續回流科技成長股；指標股台積電ADR上揚1.54％，帶動台指期夜盤先一步大漲272點，為今日台股現貨開盤奠定了強大的外資買盤基礎。

除了美股費半大漲，科技巨頭Meta推出的全新AI助理「Muse」在全球人氣爆棚，更被彭博等主流財經媒體預言可能成為AI領域的殺手級應用。這股熱潮不僅刺激Meta股價飆漲，更直接點燃了台灣AI供應鏈的戰火；資金在現貨市場開盤後，蜂擁圍繞在半導體、先進裝測、記憶體及ABF載板等相關題材進行拉抬。

ABF、記憶體全面引爆 非電族群台泥一枝獨秀

觀察今日盤面強勢族群，ABF載板族群受惠於AI晶片與先進封裝需求極度吃緊，市場傳出第四季報價將持續調漲，成為最吸金的焦點。景碩（3189）開盤後迅速攻上漲停，多方力道強勁；欣興（3037）與南電（8046）同樣受到族群共振效應帶動，亮燈漲停或大漲。

記憶體族群則因美股記憶體大廠美光與SanDisk股價飆漲逾5％，帶動台廠跌深強彈。南亞科（2408）帶量強勢開高大漲逾5％，股價一舉重回短多格局；華邦電（2344）、南茂（8150）分別大漲3％至4％以上，南茂盤中更一度觸及漲停；高價記憶體模組與IC設計股群聯（8299）與宜鼎（5289）漲幅也均超過4％。

此外，權王台積電（2330）早盤大漲20元至2,480元，扮演大盤衝鋒的核心支柱；友達（2409）傳出與台積電、英特爾擴大跨入先進封裝領域，股價展現強勁續航力；高價矽智財與台積電供應鏈的創意（3443）、力旺（3529）也獲資金青睞。非電子股方面，台泥（1101）臨時董事會通過將收購烏克蘭第二大水泥建材公司IFCEM，推進東歐市場布局，利多激勵股價盤中飆漲逾6％，成為傳產亮點。

打炒房陰影重擊營建 金融熄火、長假調節賣壓湧現

相對於電子的火熱，營建與金融族群則淪為弱勢重災區。營建族群受到先前央行打炒房政策的長線陰影壓抑，加上盤面資金高度被電子股吸走，整體營建指數盤中重挫逾2％，多檔指標型營建股皆開高走低逆勢下殺；金融族群也因美債殖利率曲線變動壓抑了銀行股獲利預期，美股大型金融股高位轉弱，蔓延至台股導致金融股今日普遍熄火。另適逢中秋與教師節長假將至，部分高位階或先前漲多的中小型股面臨長假調節賣壓，如世紀*（9958）、光鋐（4916）、豪勉（6218）等中小型股在盤中不幸打入跌停，惠特（6706）、高僑（6234）則因高檔獲利了結賣壓湧現，重挫8％以上。

名師大咖堅定喊「五萬點」 專家示警：防爆量假突破

針對今日驚天漲勢，投顧法人與市場分析師看法相對樂觀，但也維持居高思危的謹慎。摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮堅定看好長線「5萬點」行情，並大方透露自己砸下1億元買進的台灣元大50（0050）至今累計獲利突破2,200萬元，依然一股不賣；不過，也提醒投資人，面對高檔行情切勿亂追，操作應採取「低基期、右側交易」原則，等個股止跌重新轉強時再順勢布局，例如關注智原等ASIC、矽智財個股。

華南投顧董事長呂仁傑則提出警示看法，指出大盤雖然創高，但多數個股熱度其實已降溫，近期指數與個股表現明顯分歧。他提醒今天操作必須防範高檔震盪及開高走低的風

news.Title: 國家隊近3日砸18億撿緯創！聯發科反遭倒41億 友達、景碩漲停也被賣
news.Content:
台股近日持續高檔震盪，八大官股銀行資金也開始換邊布局。統計18、21、22日共3個交易日，官股前十大買超金額合計約78.31億元，前十大賣超則達210.16億元，賣超金額約為買超2.7倍；其中緯創(3231)獲買超近18億元居冠，聯發科(2454)則遭調節逾41億元，形成鮮明對比。

22日台股一度衝上48,601.53點歷史新高，終場收47,800.17點，同創收盤新高，但高低點震盪達801點，長假前獲利了結賣壓也開始浮現。

緯創越跌越買 藥華藥居第2

近3日官股買超冠軍為緯創，共買超9,736張、金額17.96億元。緯創22日下跌3.22%至180.5元，成交量放大至6.78萬張；當天外資甚至反手大賣緯創約3萬張，官股與外資操作方向明顯分歧。

第2名則是藥華藥(6446)，獲買超12.53億元；藥華藥自行研發的Ropeg今年已先後取得台灣、日本及美國原發性血小板過多症（ET）藥證，8月營收26.17億元、年增105.43%。

買超榜第3~5名依序為大華優利高填息30(00918)、南亞(1303)及智邦(2345)，買超金額分別約9.39億、6.57億及5.93億元。另有穎崴(6515)、金像電(2368)、玉晶光(3406)、雙鴻(3324)、大立光(3008)擠進前十。

對於緯創後勢，啟發投顧分析師郭憲政較為保留並指出，緯創上半年EPS為7.78元，股價估值看來不高，但今年8月盤中206元高點及200元關卡仍構成壓力；他認為，AI伺服器代工股最強的一段漲勢可能已過，短線轉強仍須觀察股價能否突破並站穩200元。

聯發科創高卻遭倒41億 友達漲停也被賣

賣超榜方面，官股操作反而集中近期強勢股。近3日官股賣超聯發科852張、金額高達41.10億元居冠；聯發科22日盤中一度衝上5,480元歷史高點，終場仍大漲3.39%收5,180元。市場近期聚焦其AI與高階運算題材。

資深分析師蔡明翰近日表示，市場已提前反映聯發科的後續獲利成長，並指出近期強勢有其預期基礎；他同時提醒，股價走高後估值已不便宜，短線操作風險升高。

台積電(2330)遭賣超27.48億元居第2，日月光投控(3711)24.85億元第3；後續依序為友達(2409)、台達電(2308)、景碩(3189)、京元電子(2449)、瑞昱(2379)、聯電(2303)及台光電(2383)。

其中反差最大的友達近3日遭官股賣超6.35萬張、約21.88億元，但22日卻以36.65元漲停作收，爆出逾115萬張大量。友達連續兩個交易日漲停，近期市場題材集中於先進封裝、CPO及資產活化，股價也部分反映與台積電、英特爾的合作傳聞。

景碩同樣遭官股調節20.74億元，22日卻漲停收909元；雙鴻則成為少數「股價強、官股也買」個股，近3日獲買超4.06億元，22日上漲5.26%至1,600元，盤中最高觸及1,630元歷史新高，市場持續反映AI伺服器水冷散熱需求。

news.Title: SK Hynix Is Eyeing Intel’s (INTC) Ohio Site. Why Micron (MU) Should Pay Attention
news.Content:
SK Hynix is exploring something it has never done before: manufacturing memory chips in the United States.

Reuters reported on September 16 that the Korean memory giant is discussing several possibilities with Intel Corporation (NASDAQ: INTC ), including leasing part of Intel's long-delayed Ohio complex or forming a venture involving Intel and large cloud customers. SK Hynix said no specific plan has been finalized.

For Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MU ), the talks matter because one of its strongest strategic advantages is being the major U.S.-based memory producer while AI has made DRAM and HBM increasingly scarce.

SK Hynix Could Give Intel Another Path for Its Delayed Ohio Site

Intel has committed enormous capital to Ohio, with the broader project potentially reaching around $100 billion over time. Delays have pushed planned production into the next decade. A tenant or joint-venture partner could therefore help Intel share the financial burden of developing the Ohio site rather than relying entirely on its own foundry demand to justify the buildout.

That is the bull case. The bear case is that exploratory talks are a long way from revenue. Bringing advanced Korean memory production to the U.S. could face cost problems, technology-transfer restrictions and objections from Seoul. Intel still needs its core manufacturing roadmap to work.

Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) sits on the other side of the equation. AI demand has pushed memory pricing and availability into a strong cycle, and Micron is already pursuing a large U.S. manufacturing expansion. More domestic manufacturing incentives and customer interest in secure supply support that plan.

A successful SK Hynix move could eventually erode part of Micron's U.S.-supply differentiation. U.S. cloud companies would gain another potential domestic supplier, while additional long-term memory capacity could eventually loosen the market that currently supports exceptional pricing.

Hedge funds loaded up on both chipmakers

Insider Monkey tracked 138 hedge funds holding Intel in Q2, up sharply from 112 in Q1. AQR Capital Management held roughly 10.7 million shares after trimming its stake about 7%. Micron's count rose to 184 funds from 154, one of the stronger quarter-over-quarter increases among large semiconductor names. Coatue Management expanded its MU stake dramatically during the quarter.

Intel had about 152.2 million shares sold short as of August 31, roughly 3% of public float and 1.7 days to cover.

The talks do not rescue Intel's foundry strategy or weaken Micron overnight. They do show what AI scarcity is doing to the supply chain. Memory manufacturing is becoming strategic enough that SK Hynix is considering putting advanced capacity on American soil, and Intel's delayed Ohio project suddenly gives it a potentially valuable asset to negotiate with.

Story Continues

news.Title: Pat Gelsinger Just Backed a $100 Million Challenge to Nvidia’s AI Networking Moat. AMD Could Benefit
news.Content:
Former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger is backing a startup that thinks AI's next bottleneck is not the accelerator. It is everything waiting for data to arrive.

Delos Data announced on September 15 that it raised more than $100 million to develop networking chips and software for increasingly heterogeneous AI data centers. Playground Global, where Gelsinger is a general partner, joined the round. Reuters reported that Delos is designing the network to work across different types of compute hardware rather than assuming every accelerator comes from NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA ).

That makes Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMD ) an important read-through even though AMD is not an investor in Delos.

For illustration purposes only. Photo by Brett Sayles on Pexels

Open networking attacks the strongest part of Nvidia's stack

Nvidia does not dominate AI simply because its GPUs are fast. NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) sells a tightly integrated system of accelerators, networking, interconnects and software. That makes large clusters easier to deploy and gives customers fewer reasons to mix architectures.

Delos is betting the market becomes less uniform as inference expands. Its pitch is that a data center should be able to connect whatever mix of accelerators makes economic sense. Gelsinger described idle compute waiting for data as a major waste of both money and energy.

If that architecture works, AMD benefits indirectly. Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMD) has been improving Instinct accelerator performance and winning AI deployments, but every friction point involved in mixing AMD hardware with another vendor's ecosystem protects Nvidia. Hardware-agnostic networking could lower that friction.

The counterargument is brutal: Nvidia already has scale, mature software and networking products customers know work. A startup with $100 million of financing is attacking an incumbent that spends billions on research and sells the full rack. Delos also has to prove its claimed performance improvements in commercial deployments.

Hedge funds increased exposure to both incumbents

Insider Monkey tracked 285 hedge funds holding Nvidia in Q2, up from 275 in Q1. Arrowstreet Capital raised its position 10% to roughly 34.7 million shares. AMD's holder count climbed to 164 from 134, while Marshall Wace held approximately 3.9 million shares after increasing its stake modestly.

AMD had about 41.7 million shares sold short as of August 31, equal to roughly 2.6% of float and 2.5 days to cover.

Story Continues

Delos does not have to replace Nvidia networking to matter. It only has to make mixed AI clusters easier to build. Nvidia's moat is strongest when customers buy the entire system together. Anything that makes the pieces more interchangeable gives AMD and every other accelerator challenger a slightly wider door.

While we acknowledge the potential of NVDA and AMD as investments, we believe certain other AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: Nvidia Stock Could Surge by 2028: Here's How Beginners Can Get In Now According to Motley Fool's Price Estimates
news.Content:
Even if you're a total novice to the stock market, you've probably heard of Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA).

Nvidia is now the most valuable company in the world, worth more than $5 trillion. Its chips have formed the backbone of the AI revolution, and the top AI labs and cloud computing platforms rely on them to make AI applications run.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

If you were fortunate enough to buy Nvidia a decade ago and hold it, you would have made a huge return as the stock is up more than 14,000% during that time. That means a $1,000 investment in Nvidia would now be worth more than $14,000.

The stock won't do that again over the next decade, but it still looks poised to soar by 2028. Here's how I see it.

Nvidia is still cheap

There's a lot of jargon in investing, but one of the most important concepts that beginning investors can learn is the price-to-earnings ratio , or P/E ratio. This is a company's price per share divided by its earnings per share.

Newbie investors often think that a stock's share price determines whether it is cheap or not. For instance, a $10 stock would be cheap and a $500 stock would be expensive, but the share price alone isn't really meaningful.

Owning a share of a stock is a claim on its earnings, so what really matters is how much earnings you get relative to the price of the stock. That's the P/E ratio. The lower it is, the cheaper the stock.

Nvidia now trades at a P/E of 29, which is slightly higher than the S&P 500's P/E ratio of 25. The S&P 500 , an index that holds 500 of the biggest U.S. stocks, is generally seen as the market average. According to the numbers above, Nvidia is a bit more expensive than the S&P 500. However, the P/E ratio is backward-looking, and stocks are priced based on future earnings or cash flows.

Because of its central position in the AI boom, Nvidia is growing much faster than the S&P 500. Wall Street expects the company to grow revenue by 91% this year and 66% next year. For fiscal 2028, which ends in January of that year, Nvidia is expected to have earnings per share of $15.68.

Based on that forecast, the stock trades at 14.6x next year's earnings. or a forward P/E of 14.6. If Nvidia maintains its current P/E ratio and hits that EPS forecast, the stock would double in less than a year and a half.

Story Continues

How to buy Nvidia stock

If you're new to investing and you want to buy Nvidia stock, you'll first need a brokerage account if you don't already have one. You can open one up with a platform like Robinhood , Interactive Brokers , E*TRADE from Morgan Stanley , or Charles Schwab . There are a lot of options for brokers.

Nvidia is currently trading around $228 a share, so you'll need that much to buy one share. However, many brokerages now offer fractional share purchasing, meaning you can buy a fraction of a share of Nvidia, allowing you to get ownership for less than the price of a share. Once you have an account, you'll need to search for the stock using the ticker, NVDA, and then choose an order type. Using a market order will execute the trade immediately and is the easiest way to buy a heavily traded stock like Nvidia. If you want to set a maximum price you're willing to pay, you can use a limit order.

Keep in mind that while Nvidia's future looks promising and the numbers favor continued gains in the stock, there is always risk in stock investing. There is no guarantee that the stock will go up between now and 2028. With any investment, it's a good idea to keep a long-term view and continue to follow the stock. Don't just buy and forget. If things change, you may want to sell.

Still, I think the odds are in your favor. As long as the AI boom continues over the next two years, Nvidia looks well-positioned to be a winner.

news.Title: Lumentum Jumped Nearly 10% While Corning Barely Moved. Is the AI Optics Trade Splitting Apart?
news.Content:
When AI stocks rebounded last week, optical networking companies did not rebound equally.

Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: LITE ) jumped nearly 10% in Wednesday trading and led the S&P 500, while Coherent rose 6.9%. Corning Incorporated (NYSE: GLW ) managed only a 0.4% gain and remained down sharply for the week.

All three sit inside the same broad AI-connectivity buildout. The divergence suggests investors are beginning to distinguish between different pieces of that infrastructure rather than buying every optics name together.

Photo from Lumentum Holdings website

Lumentum offers concentrated exposure to the bandwidth problem

AI clusters increasingly need optical connections as more accelerators communicate across larger physical distances. That drives demand for high-speed transceivers, lasers and other photonic components.

For Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE), concentrated exposure is both the attraction and the risk. Strong hyperscaler spending can create powerful operating leverage as faster generations of optical links ramp. The same concentration can produce violent corrections when investors question the pace of AI spending or customer deployments.

Corning Incorporated (NYSE:GLW) has a broader business and participates through optical fiber and connectivity infrastructure. The company benefits as hyperscalers build new campuses and connect larger networks, but that exposure is less directly tied to the highest-value transceiver components.

Corning also introduced a fresh complication. A September filing established an equity distribution agreement allowing the company to sell up to $2 billion of stock through Goldman Sachs. That gives Corning capital flexibility for large projects, but potential issuance creates dilution at a moment when investors are already scrutinizing the cost of AI infrastructure expansion.

Professional investors also split on the two names

Insider Monkey's database showed Lumentum ownership falling to 111 hedge funds in Q2 from 123 in Q1. Arrowstreet Capital nevertheless increased its position sharply during the quarter. Corning moved the other way, rising to 99 hedge-fund holders from 91, while Tairen Capital increased its GLW position by roughly 9%.

Lumentum's August 31 short interest stood at about 7.12 million shares, nearly 8% of public float, with approximately 1.7 days to cover. That makes positioning meaningfully heavier than in many large-cap AI infrastructure names.

The takeaway from the rebound is not that Lumentum won and Corning lost. Their economics are different. Lumentum offers more concentrated exposure to high-speed optical components, while Corning offers broader exposure to the fiber-heavy physical buildout underneath them. When the AI trade becomes selective, that distinction suddenly matters.

Story Continues

news.Title: Intel (INTC) Could Get a Fresh Valuation for Altera. AMD (AMD) Is the Rival to Watch
news.Content:
Intel sold control of Altera last year. Now the programmable-chip company is heading back toward the public market just as AI gives investors a new reason to care about FPGAs.

Altera said on September 15 that it confidentially filed for a U.S. IPO. Reuters previously reported that the offering could raise more than $2 billion. Silver Lake owns 51% after investing $4.46 billion for control, while Intel Corporation (NASDAQ: INTC ) retains 49%.

Intel Corp.'s headquarters, the Robert Noyce Building in Santa Clara, California. Photo from Intel Corp website

The most useful strategic comparison is Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMD ), which bought FPGA leader Xilinx in 2022 and integrated programmable silicon into a much broader data-center portfolio.

The IPO could put a price on an asset Intel partially kept

Intel bought Altera for $16.7 billion in 2015 before separating the business and selling control to Silver Lake. An IPO would create a new market valuation for Intel Corporation's (NASDAQ:INTC) remaining interest.

That matters because Intel needs capital. Its foundry expansion requires enormous spending while the company is still trying to restore competitiveness in conventional CPUs and advanced manufacturing. A strong Altera valuation could therefore crystallize value in an asset investors currently bury inside Intel's much larger turnaround.

The downside is that IPO appetite for anything carrying an AI label can run ahead of operating reality. Altera makes programmable chips across industrial, communications, aerospace and data-center markets. Management has projected mid-20% revenue growth in 2026, but investors will still have to determine how much of that growth is genuinely AI-driven.

Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMD) shows what Altera ultimately has to compete against. Xilinx gave AMD FPGAs, adaptive SoCs and software that can sit beside its EPYC CPUs and Instinct accelerators. That bundle can be attractive in heterogeneous systems. The bear case is that AMD paid heavily to assemble that portfolio, and integrating multiple product families does not guarantee every FPGA workload migrates into AMD's ecosystem.

Funds became much more interested in both chipmakers

Insider Monkey counted 138 hedge funds holding Intel in Q2, up from 112 in Q1. AQR Capital Management held about 10.7 million shares after trimming its stake roughly 7%. AMD ownership jumped to 164 funds from 134, while Marshall Wace held about 3.9 million shares after a modest increase.

Intel had approximately 152.2 million shares sold short on August 31, about 3% of public float.

Story Continues

Altera's offering terms have not been set, so $2 billion remains a reported fundraising possibility rather than a finalized deal. What the IPO could do is make a hidden part of Intel easier to value while giving investors a fresh public benchmark against AMD's Xilinx strategy.

news.Title: AMD just hit a milestone that reshuffles the AI chip race
news.Content:
On Lisa Su's first day as chief executive in October 2014, a share of Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) cost just over $3 , according to CNBC . That was about the price of a latte. By year end, the whole company was worth roughly $2 billion , the same report found.

On Monday, September 21, 2026, AMD crossed $1 trillion in market value as its stock rose for a fifth straight session, CNBC reported . It finally joined the trillion-dollar club.

The trigger was not a new chip or a new customer. Shares jumped 9.17% in morning trading on reports of a 10% price increase on some AI accelerators and GPUs.

That is unusual for a challenger. Challengers usually cut prices to win share from the leader. AMD is doing the opposite, a sign that buyers now pay for access.

Related: Jim Cramer sends a blunt message to AMD stock investors

The rally also lifted the stock past its previous $584.73 high, according to FinanceFeeds , and above $600 for the first time. That matters because OpenAI and Meta Platforms (META) hold warrants for up to 320 million AMD shares, with final tranches tied to $600 , the analysis found.

The milestone and the payout line now sit side by side.

AMD stock more than tripled in a year

AMD designs the processors inside PCs, game consoles and, increasingly, AI data centers. Reuters regards it as Nvidia's (NVDA) closest rival in graphics processors. That makes the stock a popular bet on AI spending spreading beyond one supplier.

The shares were already up about 3% before the opening bell on Monday, according to Benzinga . The same report put the gain over the past year near 250% , the earnings multiple near 143 and the average analyst price target at $604 .

The stock now trades above it, leaving analysts to catch up.

Nvidia's data center unit booked $89 billion in its latest quarter, roughly 13 times AMD's, according to Nvidia's earnings release . Yet Nvidia's $5.37 trillion market value is only about five times AMD's, according to StockAnalysis .

Investors are pricing AMD on the share it could win, not the share it holds.

AMD is raising prices instead of cutting them

AMD has notified partners of a roughly 10% fourth quarter price increase, Digital Trends reported , citing supply chain outlet ChannelGate. It names AI accelerators, consumer GPUs and chipsets, citing a similar rise in foundry prices at Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM).

AMD has not confirmed the report, which Stocktwits described as unverified.

Buyers are paying anyway. Cloud operator Nebius Group (NBIS) will raise rental rates on AMD's EPYC server chips by 25% , versus 17% to 21% for Nvidia GPUs, according to The Motley Fool .

Story Continues

Piper Sandler said 2027 AI capacity is already sold out, Benzinga reported . Because the increase largely passes along foundry costs, the signal is less about margins and more about who holds leverage.

Earnings back that up. Second quarter revenue rose 50% to $11.54 billion , and data center revenue more than doubled to $6.72 billion , AMD reported .

More AMD:

Jim Cramer sends a blunt message to AMD stock investors

Bank of America sends wake-up call to AMD stock investors

Nvidia just sent a strong signal to AMD and Intel investors

AMD's biggest buyers hold warrants tied to $600

In October 2025, AMD granted OpenAI a warrant for up to 160 million shares at $0.01 each, according to an SEC filing .

AMD repeated the structure in February 2026, when Meta agreed to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD gear, Bloomberg reported . Both warrants escalate to $600 for their last tranches, according to AMD's filings .

The final OpenAI tranche needs roughly a $1 trillion market value to vest, UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri wrote in a note cited by TechCrunch . Benzinga puts that line near $613 a share on AMD's reported count. At that price, the 320 million warrant shares would be worth about $196 billion .

Counting those warrants changes the picture:

Full vesting requires OpenAI and Meta to each buy 6 gigawatt s of AMD chips, according to the filings.

About $1.09 trillion was AMD's value at its $559.82 close on Friday, September 18, 2026, with both warrants included, according to FinanceFeeds .

Roughly 19.6% more shares would exist if both warrants fully vest, the analysis added.

Chipmakers now help finance their own buyers

AMD and Nvidia both back their buyers financially, a pattern Fortune has tied to circular financing fears. Nvidia has weighed guaranteeing $250 billion for an OpenAI data center project, Axios reported .

AMD committed up to $5 billion to Anthropic, CNBC reported , but its bigger currency is its own stock. Nvidia shareholders carry the credit risk, while AMD shareholders carry the dilution.

Memory maker Micron Technology (MU) reached $1 trillion in May 2026, before AMD did, according to The Motley Fool . Investors paid first for bottlenecks, and AMD's price increase suggests it has become one.

AMD's next report, due November 3, 2026, will show whether the first gigawatts are shipping.

The chip race once turned on who built the fastest chip. It now also turns on pricing power and how much equity a supplier will trade for demand.

展望後市，法人點名AI伺服器、PCB與ABF載板、測試介面、半導體設備、電源及散熱等族群值得留意。市場認為，隨著AI基本面持續強勁，加上第四季電子消費旺季到來，資金可望持續尋找具產業成長題材及基本面支撐的企業。

從盤面來看，AI供應鏈近期也出現多點開花，包括信驊突破2萬元、聯發科創下歷史新高，PCB、ABF載板及半導體相關個股同步走強，顯示資金焦點已不只集中在台積電，而是逐步向AI伺服器、先進封裝、載板、電源、散熱等周邊環節擴散。

不過，台股短線在創高後仍面臨獲利了結壓力，22日盤中便出現近900點震盪。法人認為，後續市場除了觀察AI需求能否持續，也要留意資金輪動與國際市場變化，台股能否延續高檔行情，仍須回到企業營收與獲利表現檢驗。

news.Title: Should You Buy Micron Before Sept. 30? 1 Number Could Send the Stock Soaring
news.Content:
Micron (NASDAQ:MU) is set to report fourth-quarter earnings after the bell on Sept. 30.

The memory chip giant has been one of the most closely watched stocks in the AI boom after soaring more than 1,000% as AI compute demand has sparked an unprecedented shortage of memory. As a result, revenue and profits for Micron and its peers have skyrocketed.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

As one of the three leading memory chip companies in the world, along with Samsung and SK Hynix , Micron , the only U.S. stock in the group, has emerged as a popular choice for investors who want exposure to the bottleneck.

The stock is likely to swing big following its earnings report, as its results have been difficult for Wall Street to predict, and because the stock is historically volatile due to the cyclicality of memory.

Image source: Getty Images.

The 1 number to watch when Micron reports Q4 earnings

Investors will be tracking key numbers from the quarterly report, like revenue, adjusted earnings per share, and gross margin, and Micron's guidance will help determine where the stock goes next.

However, I think the most important factor in the report will be commentary on market dynamics, particularly for 2028. Yes, 2028, not the company's financial figures, will be the most important number to watch.

2028 is key because the company has already said that its high-bandwidth memory, specifically HBM3E and HBM4, are fully booked through calendar 2027. That means the company's results through the next calendar year are more or less predictable. What's still unknown is how supply and demand dynamics impact the company's performance in 2028 and beyond.

On the Q3 call in June, management said that HBM demand had begun to stretch into 2028, and it also expects new capacity to come online, meaning 2028 could be another bumper year if memory prices remain elevated.

The future outweighs the present for Micron

Where Micron stock goes from here largely depends on investor perception of how long the AI-driven boom will last. That's what's unknown about the stock. Investors are already well aware that the company will make huge profits in fiscal 2027 and 2028, but the cycle will eventually peak. What matters is whether that's five years away or more, or whether it's just two or three years away.

Story Continues

Management commentary on 2028 will give investors the biggest hint about whether the peak of the cycle is getting pushed further out. If we hear a positive update on 2028 or more commentary on tight market dynamics, I think that will push the stock higher. Without that, a gain is less likely.

Micron is insulating itself from the cyclical downside

Micron has already taken steps to protect itself from the other side of the cycle. It has begun signing strategic customer agreements (SCA), most of which last five years. These agreements lock in a price range and are structured as take-or-pay agreements with minimum purchase commitments, protecting Micron from a potential bust in the cycle. The agreements it signed through the third quarter covered about 20% of DRAM volume and 33% of NAND volume, indicating it's protecting a significant share of its business.

While Micron is taking prudent steps with the current memory windfall, it remains bullish on long-term demand, pouring $100 billion into a new manufacturing facility in upstate New York, which is expected to begin producing chips in 2029 or 2030.

Overall, Micron is on solid footing heading into the report. The stock looks cheap relative to near-term earnings forecasts, and it has risen in recent days from a potential surge in CPU demand, driven by Meta Platforms' breakthrough launch of its Muse AI personal agent.

Given those factors, I think the stock is a buy heading into the report, but its commentary about 2028 could be the biggest determinant in where Micron stock goes after the earnings report and over the coming months.

news.Title: 標普500逼近新高、個股卻頻創新低 美股浮現1999年式罕見背離 岡拉克怎麼操作？
news.Content:
美股主要指數近期持續逼近歷史高點，但指數表面強勢之下，個股表現卻出現罕見分化。9月21日交易中，標普500指數上漲1.49%, 收在7,764.70點，距離歷史高點不到1%, 同日那斯達克綜合指數上漲約2%, 創下收盤新高。然而，標普500成分股中卻有30檔股票觸及52週新低, 僅7檔創下52週新高，形成指數上漲與市場廣度惡化並存的異常格局。

更值得注意的是，若將觀察區間從52週擴大至60日及120日，市場內部弱勢程度同樣明顯。最新統計顯示，標普500成分股中，近3個交易日創60日新低的股票達99檔，創60日新高的僅28檔；創120日新低的股票達77檔，創120日新高的僅22檔。換言之，即使指數已經逼近歷史高點，個股層面的下跌壓力仍然廣泛存在。

這種現象被市場策略師視為「市場廣度」與指數走勢之間的重大背離。9月21日的特殊之處並不只是新低股票多於新高股票，而是標普500單日上漲至少1%, 同時距離歷史高點不到1%, 卻仍出現新低股多於新高股的組合。SentimenTrader創辦人、NextGen News顧問Jason Goepfert指出，往前追溯近百年，符合這組條件的前一次案例是1999年12月21日, 更早則是1929年7月23日。

不過，這項歷史比較本身並不代表市場即將重演1929年或1999年的走勢。兩個歷史案例距離後續市場重大轉折都有數月時間，而且樣本極少，因此更適合作為市場廣度異常的歷史參照，而非單獨用來判斷後市方向。

目前的另一個警訊是指數內部的參與程度。近期資料顯示，標普500成分股中，站在50日移動平均線之上的股票比例不到30%, 顯示推動指數上漲的股票數量相對有限。換言之，標普500指數仍然具有韌性，但指數上漲並未同步擴散至大部分成分股。

從產業結構來看，近期漲勢主要集中在資訊科技、通訊服務及非必需消費品等板塊。其中資訊科技類股距離52週高點不到1%, 但通訊服務及非必需消費品仍分別落後各自高點約4%及7%。B. Riley Financial (RILY-US)旗下B. Riley Wealth首席市場策略師Art Hogan表示，市場領漲板塊目前正努力抵抗板塊輪動帶來的壓力，而已經遭到拋售的股票，由於距離前低較近，因此形成新低的難度反而較低。

Hogan同時指出，如果中東局勢持續影響市場情緒，類似的市場廣度分化可能在未來幾個月間零星出現。他認為，若戰事持續、能源價格維持高位, 同時聯準會需要維持偏緊縮的利率政策, 市場要再創歷史新高將面臨更大阻力。近期市場也持續受到中東局勢、油價及利率預期牽動。9月22日交易中，標普500小幅走弱, 道瓊工業指數下跌逾290點, 金融股成為主要拖累，而市場仍關注油價接近每桶100美元所帶來的通膨壓力。

市場情緒同樣出現變化。不過，原稿所稱高盛情緒指標最新降至負0.9需要加以釐清。高盛研究資料顯示，美國市場情緒指標曾在3月底降至負0.9, 隨後回升至正0.8, 因此負0.9並非目前最新讀數。

在市場廣度出現異常之際, DoubleLine Capital創辦人兼執行長傑佛瑞・岡拉克(Jeffrey Gundlach)則進一步將焦點放在人工智慧交易。他以2007年美國房地產泡沫判斷而受到市場關注，近期表示自己正在盡可能降低投資組合對AI交易的曝險，並直言「我只想退出」。不過，岡拉克也強調，他並非全面拋售股票，也沒有放空AI相關股票，而是希望遠離他認為可能承受最大損失的市場區域。

岡拉克認為，AI投資敘事已經從「一切都很美好」的階段轉向投資人開始重新檢視風險。他指出，市場過去對AI能力及商業前景抱持高度樂觀態度，但如今開始出現對技術能力、資本支出及企業融資需求的疑問。岡拉克並表示，AI交易何時真正出現崩跌，他自己也無法確定，但認為市場已經接近需要更加謹慎看待的階段。

他尤其關注AI相關企業快速增加的資本需求及信用市場變化，認為企業為了AI基礎建設而大量借貸，可能在利率或資金成本上升時放大金融市場風險。此外，他也提到SpaceX潛在市場規模的龐大估值。市場報導指出，馬斯克曾將相關潛在市場規模估計為28.5兆美元。岡拉克認為，如果少數企業最終占據如此龐大的AI市場，市場利益不可能平均分配，因此AI競賽中勢必會出現失敗者。

news.Title: 台積電最強「親兒子」超狂！外資喊1.2萬目標價：獲利可望翻8倍
news.Content:
台股多頭氣勢升溫，高價IC設計族群表現亮眼，聯發科昨一度衝上5480元，刷新歷史天價；創意同樣強勢，今股價攻上8540元，再創新高，短線漲幅突破4成。市場買盤受到外資最新報告激勵，Aletheia Capital首度將創意納入研究，並給予「買進」評等，目標價更喊至12000元，遠高於目前股價，帶動市場追價買盤湧入，推升股價強勢走高。

創意為台積電轉投資公司，隨著ASIC業務大好，可說是台積電最強的「親兒子」。創意最近更獲外資Aletheia Capital首度納入研究，直接給予「買進」評等，目標價喊到驚人的12000元。

Aletheia Capital指出，隨著代理型AI工作負載快速增加，加上全球算力成本持續攀升，Google、微軟等雲端服務供應商（CSP）與AI實驗室正加速投入自研ASIC，創意可望成為這波趨勢的重要受惠者。其優勢不僅來自完整的矽智財（IP）組合，也包括先進封裝、統包服務，以及與台積電設計建置服務（DTP）部門的緊密合作。

報告進一步指出，創意目前產品線已從Google、微軟的自研CPU，逐步拓展至多家CSP客製化ASIC，預期2027年N3、N5製程晶圓分配量將增加約5倍，反映委託設計（NRE）案轉化為量產營收的能力持續提升。

在財務表現方面，外資預估創意2026年營收將翻倍，2027年更可能大幅成長4倍，2028年再增加約50%；受惠營運槓桿效益，2026至2028年EPS合計可望成長約8倍。

報告預估創意2026年EPS達52.75元、年增87.52%，2027年進一步攀升至123.46元、年增134%，遠高於目前市場預期。

隨全球AI ASIC市場持續擴張，創意能否將龐大的AI需求進一步轉化為實際營收與獲利，將成為市場接下來追蹤的關鍵。報告同時提醒，市場需求變化與團隊執行力仍是主要風險。

news.Title: 【台股盤中】電子水泥強勢　台股盤中揚升541點攀高至48341點
news.Content:

其餘電子權值股鴻海 (2317) 、日月光投控 (3711) 、台光電 (2383) 、欣興 (3037) 及高價股健策 (3653) 、奇鋐 (3017) 、旺矽 (6223) 、穎崴 (6515) 也紛紛走高，推升整體電子類股指數上漲逾1.4%。（編輯：張良知）

news.Title: 台股創新高爆「虛胖」危機！個股賠慘 散戶小心2大衝擊
news.Content:
台股昨（22日）創下48601.53點歷史新高，但上市櫃有超過千檔收跌，顯示多數個股仍無法跟上大盤，形成「虛胖」結構，尤其最大權值股台積電並未突破2535元歷史新高，成為最大警訊，另有專家提醒，台股需要小心假突破、真拉回的風險。

大盤漲瘋、個股趴地 散戶其實沒賺？

台股昨日盤中一度大漲將近900點，但尾盤漲勢快速收斂，最終僅小漲81點，且千金股走勢嚴重分歧，僅聯發科、創意、信驊等高價股噴出，權值股也僅有富邦金、聯發科及南亞等個股跟隨台股創新高。

嚴重分化的狀況顯示市場缺乏廣度，如果權值股熄火或出現獲利了結賣壓，缺乏其他接棒族群，大盤極易出現陡峭的大拉回。知名分析師蔡明翰於《鈔錢部署》節目中表示，投資人必須小心假突破、真拉回的風險。

台股浮現危機 散戶小心這件事

蔡明翰認為，後市觀察指標在於美國費城半導體指數的狀況，如果費城半導體指數未能轉強，台股的表現也會受到壓抑，且台股在高點時也要提高警覺心，防範拉回風險。

另外，蔡明翰認為美債殖利率不是牽動股市發展的最重要原因，過往疫情與歐債危機造成股市下跌時，殖利率往往是在低檔徘徊，且只要利率沒有出現快速升息的極端狀況，股市就能避免重大打擊。

從過往狀況來看，當個股與大盤的背離狀況達到極致時，通常會出現三種狀況，其中以撐盤權值股補跌，使大盤出現修正的機率最高，另有可能出現橫盤整理，資金向低基期族群流動，進而出現補漲，或者漲多後震盪，個股劇烈洗盤。

news.Title: 重壓0050爽賺2千萬！ 郭哲榮喊「絕不出清」：台股上看10萬點
news.Content:
台股近日多頭氣勢強勁，22日再度創新高來到48601點。摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮日前曾在7月底重挫時，重壓1億元搶進元大台灣50（0050），不到兩個月帳面獲利逼近2000萬元，他表示「獲利絕不出清」，並認為台股3年內上看10萬點。

重壓0050一億報酬率近20%

郭哲榮曾在今年7月29日、台股指數跌破4萬點時，豪砸1億元買進1100張0050，每股均價約93元；後續台股強力反彈，截至9月22日帳面獲利更衝上1987萬元、報酬率近20%。

櫃買指數具補漲空間

針對大盤創高後遇到獲利賣壓，郭哲榮分析，主因在於美股費城半導體、那斯達克指數尚未同步創新高，而台股暫時領先，部分資金選擇先行獲利了結。不過，雖已創新高，但櫃買（OTC）距離前高尚有明顯差距，這個「位階差」預示著中小型股可能迎來補漲行情，是資金下一步輪動的重要觀察指標。

看好台股3年上10萬點

郭哲榮預言，台股3年內有機會挑戰10萬點，其3大核心支撐分別為：

一、國際資金面趨穩

美國10年期公債殖利率自高位回落，加上地緣政治風險降低，國際油價下滑，全球緊縮壓力減輕，提供台股強大支撐。

二、AI產業強勁動能

Meta推出的AI產品Muse以雲端代理模式熱銷，iOS下載量達180萬次，遠超過ChatGPT初期成績，間接帶動晶片（ASIC）及矽智財（IP）等硬體需求，助攻台廠業績。

三、低基期與右側交易點燃輪動

如聯發科（2454）盤中飆上新高，低基期個股智原（3035）、精材（3374）、環球晶（6488）等「右側交易」標的陸續浮現，帶動盤面新一輪攻勢。

「右側交易」擁抱多頭趨勢

郭哲榮提醒，行情創高時更宜以「右側交易」取代悲觀猜底的左側投資思維，待趨勢明朗後進場，順勢布局AI主軸、低基期輪動標的，把握多頭紅利。

news.Title: Bank of America backs Meta stock after Muse surprise
news.Content:
Bank of America is sticking with its Buy rating on Meta Platforms ( META ) stock after an early AI surprise began changing how investors view the company's tech spending.

That surprise is Muse, Meta's consumer AI assistant, launched on Sept. 8. The app can browse websites, organize email, and complete multi-step tasks with limited user intervention, pushing Meta beyond chatbots toward a practical digital agent.

Early adoption has given the bull case momentum, while the strong initial numbers add weight to the argument that Meta could turn billions in AI infrastructure spending into a differentiated consumer product.

Muse is beginning to provide an answer, but it remains early. Nevertheless, it seems investors are catching on, with Meta stock rising a tremendous 36% over the past month, dwarfing the broader market gains of just 1.2%, according to Seeking Alpha data .

BofA nevertheless believes the launch has strengthened Meta's AI trajectory and improved the case for its stock.

BofA says Muse can reprice Meta's AI story

Bank of America reiterated its Buy rating on Meta Platforms and set an $810 price target. That represents 9.3% upside from the firm's $741.25 reference price, although the potential return narrows to roughly 8% using the Sept. 22 intraday price.

More AI:

Nvidia just made a move Wall Street wasn't ready for

Microsoft just took sides in AI policy fight

OpenAI just disclosed something genuinely alarming

In a BofA note shared with The Street, the company said its new Muse offering might finally put to rest many of the concerns surrounding Meta if it can deliver a differentiated consumer product.

The early numbers look promising.

Citing Sensor Tower, BofA said Muse surpassed 2.5 million cumulative U.S. downloads by Sept. 19 and reached approximately 557,000 daily active users. Its 1.43 million iOS downloads through day 12 also edged ChatGPT's 1.37 million at the same stage.

Muse's ability to execute multistep tasks, including managing email, booking travel, and completing transactions, separates it from conventional chatbots. Moreover, Meta can eventually promote the agent across its platforms, serving 3.6 billion daily users, creating a powerful distribution advantage few competitors can match.

Independent testing found Muse genuinely useful but potentially uncomfortable due to the personal access it requires.

That said, robust retention could lift Meta's valuation before Muse contributes meaningful revenue, but downloads alone will not prove lasting demand.

Meta faces a multibillion-dollar compute decision

Story Continues

Muse also raises an important question for Meta: Should it use its limited AI computing power for its own products or sell that capacity to outside customers?

In its note, BofA estimates that external leasing could generate up to $40 billion per gigawatt, based on recent industry transactions. Leasing would create visible revenue and provide faster evidence that Meta's infrastructure buildout can earn an acceptable return.

Management, however, believes consumer agents and AI-enhanced advertising could ultimately create greater value.

The stakes are massive, to say the least. Meta expects 2026 capital expenditures of $130 billion to $145 billion, compared with $72.22 billion during 2025, Reuters noted. Every unit of compute is therefore an opportunity-cost decision, not just a technical allocation.

Muse currently offers a free tier alongside $20 and $100 monthly subscriptions. BofA does not expect subscriptions, advertising, or commerce commissions to become financially meaningful before 2028.

On the flip side, Jefferies illustrated the longer-term opportunity differently. Its scenario assumes one billion users by the end of 2027 and 3% paid conversion, producing $10.8 billion in annualized revenue.

Prioritizing Muse, therefore, sacrifices potentially lucrative leasing income for a broader platform bet spanning subscriptions, commerce, APIs, and advertising.

Early engagement will help determine whether that trade pays off.

Related: Nasdaq just put SpaceX stock investors on notice

Investor takeaway: Meta's execution must catch valuation setup

Meta stock no longer carries the deep discount that protected investors earlier in the year. BofA said shares trade near 21 times its 2027 earnings estimate, up from approximately 16 times several months ago.

Its $810 target applies a 24-times multiple to estimated 2027 GAAP earnings, representing a slight premium to the S&P 500. With only about 8% upside from the intraday level on Tuesday, Sept. 22, the margin for disappointment has narrowed considerably.

That makes Muse a supporting catalyst rather than a complete investment thesis. Investors need to see downloads translate into durable usage, paid subscriptions, commerce activity, or measurable advertising gains before pricing in further multiple expansion.

The risks are interconnected.

Muse requires access to sensitive accounts, creating privacy and trust concerns. Amazon has already blocked the agent from shopping on its platform, demonstrating how third-party restrictions could weaken Muse's usefulness and commerce ambitions.

Meanwhile, Meta's $130 billion to $145 billion spending plan pressures free cash flow and raises the cost of misjudging AI demand. Investors should monitor retention, paid conversion, task-processing costs, partner access, and 2027 spending guidance.

Muse has improved Meta's AI narrative. At this valuation, however, it must become a monetizable habit instead of just an impressive demonstration.

news.Title: 雍智科技Q3營收拚新高 Q4續揚可期
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-23 09:57:16 王怡茹 發佈

半導體測試介面廠雍智科技(6683)自結2026年8月營收2.33億元，月增1.36%、年增25.74%，稅前淨利4,900萬元、年減11%，稅後淨利3,500萬元、年減22%，EPS 1.3元。展望後市，法人表示，受惠AI、HPC及網通相關測試介面訂單挹注，預期第三季營收再創單季新高，第四季動能進一步向上。

雍智科技第一大客戶為聯發科(2454)，雙方長期在網通、手機、PC及車用等測試介面合作，2021年再結盟日系夥伴切入5G手機AP供應鏈，2025年跨入AI PC相關測試介面。針對新一代TPU部分，據悉，近期雍智科技已順利通過大客戶驗證，惟因採購策略有變數，有可能由晶圓廠拿下多數訂單配額，公司取得部分訂單，後續仍需觀察。

值得注意的是，雍智8月營收改寫歷史單月新高，惟獲利較去年同期下滑。法人分析，公司近年成長較快的前段晶圓探針卡業務，探針頭部分需由外部合作夥伴供應，相較既有測試介面產品成本較高，加上新產品仍需經歷學習曲線，對毛利率形成壓力，加上匯率因素干擾，致使8月獲利不如期。

不過，法人看好，後續隨經濟規模擴大、生產效率提升及產品組合優化，雍智科技相關成本結構有望逐步改善，今年毛利率、獲利仍將優於去年。以明年成長動能來看，在AI、HPC浪潮下，公司仍占據有利位置，全年營運表現是否能進一步跳升，則需觀察TPU專案進度、生產效率提升狀況。

news.Title: 台股衝史高「市值全球第4大」！法人看旺伺服器、載板、電源、散熱　還有這些族群值得留意
news.Content:
[ FTNN新聞網 ]財經中心／綜合報導

在美國科技股走揚的激勵下，台股於昨（22）日連袂走揚，昨早盤在市值龍頭股領漲下，大漲882.69點來到48601.53點，改寫盤中新高，爾後雖遭獲利調節賣壓，終場漲幅收斂至81.33點，最終收在47800.17點也是寫下收盤新高紀錄。市場法人表示，隨台股收復先前回檔修正的失土，根據MarketCapWatch網站所公布之最新全球主要股市市值排名，台股市值已躍居全球第四大，而想跟隨台股成長行情，能機動調整持股的主動市值ETF可說是最為便利的工具，既享大型龍頭股的底氣，也能把握重點趨勢/題材股的成長行情。

群益投信主動式台股ETF研究團隊表示，近年來台股市值前50大跟隨產業發展與當時市況而持續洗牌，回顧2020-2022年因新冠疫情影響而令面板、載板、航運類股備受市場關注，爾後在AI科技於全球掀起浪潮下，2023至2024年AI基建題材火熱，也讓伺服器、ASIC、散熱等重點個股市值躍進，進入2025年後至今，隨AI需求擴散，PCB、記憶體、測試成為資金布局重點，其2025年更是近十年市值前50大企業替換高峰。正因主流產業更替，建議投資人可透過主動市值ETF來掌握，以跟隨市場結構動態調整，網羅當代核心企業，掌握台股成長和新動能。

主動群益核心50 (00415A)經理人許育誌表示，先前受中東局勢不穩與國際股市去槓桿的影響，台股一度拉回修正，不過隨著不確定性逐一解除、聯準會如期升息之利空淡化，以及台灣央行不跟進升息緩解國內資金成本上漲壓力，在AI科技基本面強勁與第四季電子消費旺季等利多支持下，有助吸引資金回流布局市值龍頭股與重點AI趨勢股，後市表現值得關注，包括AI伺服器、PCB/ABF、測試介面、半導體設備、電源與散熱等類股表現值得留意。

◎《FTNN新聞網》提醒您：本資料僅供參考，投資人應獨立判斷，審慎評估並自負投資風險。

news.Title: 台股開盤》台積2500元領軍 大盤站上48K 分析師揭：小心「爆量不漲」
news.Content:
[Newtalk新聞] 台股今天(23日)開紅走高漲逾498點，最高來到48341點，上櫃電子早盤揚升，金融走跌！台積電漲40元、來到2500元，聯發科跌25元、來到5150元。台達電漲15元、來到1915元。廣達跌1元、來到341元。鴻海漲3元、來到256元。

分析師林漢偉表示，今天掌握三個重點：「48000點、科技創高、量能」如下。

第一，美股科技股多頭延續，費半上漲2.06%，美光大漲5.02%，安謀同步走強，顯示資金持續鎖定記憶體、IC設計與半導體，對今天台股電子族群形成正面支撐。

第二，台指期夜盤上漲272點，台積電ADR上漲1.54%，台積電期貨也來到2515元，今天指數具備挑戰48000點條件。不過位置已經來到高檔，真正關鍵是成交量能否「溫和擴增」，避免出現爆量不漲。

第三，中小型股輪動仍然活躍。記憶體看南亞科、華邦電；IC設計看聯發科、信驊、創意；AI供應鏈看智邦、健策、川湖、高力；矽光子則觀察聯亞、華星光整理後能否重新轉強。

林漢偉進一步指出，如果指數站上48000點，同時外資現貨維持買超、櫃買同步突破反壓，代表多頭結構仍有延續空間；反之若指數創高但量價背離，就要提高追價警覺。總結：美科技股續創新高、台積電ADR再漲1.54%；台股挑戰48000點，補量有利續攻，個股鎖定記憶體、IC設計與輪動補漲AI供應鏈。

news.Title: 〈台股開盤〉長假前拚站穩4萬8  台積電率高人氣電子股衝鋒漲500點
news.Content:
台股成交量能不再萎縮，台股指標股權王台積電 (2330-TW) 在除息7元後表現堅挺，今(23)日早盤股價攻堅站上2500元，上漲1.42%，激勵台股集中市場開盤上漲逾500點，最高達48341.56點。在電子股高人氣帶動之下，台股盤勢仍呈現高檔耐高檔震盪格局。

台北股市集中市場大盤23日早盤開盤在47894.77點，最低47894.77點，最高達48341.56點，預估全場成交值超過1億元，大盤成交比重上，電子股上漲1.28%，占大盤成交比重86%，金融股下跌0.69%，占大盤成交比重1%。

台股早盤台積電股價上漲，PCB材料的台光電(2383-TW)漲190元衝破5000元大關，台燿(6274-TW)，唯聯茂(6213-TW)股價下跌； 大立光(3008-TW)下跌85元1.33%、玉晶光(3406-TW)上漲0.87%，今國光(6209-TW)在紅外線鏡頭銷表現佳，9月營收可望改寫新高，早盤有大筆資金急拉，最高達81.5元。

在 IC 載板股方面，欣興 (3037-TW)及景碩 (3189-TW)、南電 (8046-TW)則均出現明顯上漲走勢，並以南電走勢較強。

今天早晨收盤的美股方面，美股晶片股延續漲勢，帶動那斯達克指數連日創收盤新高，費城半導體指數升超 2%，連續第六個交易日收高。銀行股受到美債殖利率曲線趨平壓抑，道瓊下跌 185 點。油價連續第五日走低，則為大盤提供支撐。同時，布蘭特原油期貨下滑 1.09%，收每桶 99.25 美元；西德州原油期貨下跌 1.24%，收每桶 94.59 美元，兩者均連續第五個交易日收黑。

美股的收盤表現上，道瓊工業指數下跌 185.14 點，或 0.36%，報 51,863.69 點。那斯達克指數上漲 122.18 點，或 0.45%，報 27,244.28 點。S&P 500 指數下跌 0.06 點，幾乎持平，報 7,764.64 點。費城半導體指數上漲 256.65 點，或 2.06%，報 12,689.82 點。輝達 (NVDA-US) 漲 0.66%，台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 1.54%

國票證券指出，AI驅動邏輯晶片與記憶體擴產，帶動長約價格持續上行，產業展望持續往樂觀發展，加上其位階相比其他族群相對較低，有望吸引後續投資人關注。

統一證券指出，美債殖利率止穩搭配油價跌破百元，為科技股提供買盤支撐，費半指數強勢連6漲；回歸台股，受惠AI強勁基本面，台股昨再創歷史新高，目前技術面維持強勢，搭配外銷訂單寫下連19紅及Meta Connect 2026大會等利多，多方動能充沛。但本週五起適逢中秋與教師節長假效應，仍須提防盤中大幅波動，

統一證券預期大盤將維持震盪盤堅走揚，操作建議擇優布局流動性佳的中大型AI權值股，及業績題材股 ，長線追蹤族群：台積電及先進封測、半導體設備、PCB、光傳輸、散熱、連接器、貨櫃散裝、特用化學及高殖利率銀行及壽險股等。

news.Title: 【Yahoo早盤】台股漲逾500點重返4萬8 投顧董座呂仁傑：慎防開高走低
news.Content:
美股半導體類股走強，加上國際油價回落、美債殖利率下滑，台股今（23）日加權指數以47,894.77點開出、上漲94.6點，盤中漲幅擴大逾500點，最高觸及48,341.56點，資金明顯湧向記憶體及被動元件族群。華南投顧董事長呂仁傑表示，近期指數與個股表現明顯分歧，「大盤雖然創高，多數個股熱度卻已降溫」，今天仍須防範高檔震盪及開高走低風險，盤中有三大觀察重點。

今日值班分析師：華南投顧董事長呂仁傑

呂仁傑指出，今日盤中有三大觀察重點，首先是台積電能否守穩2,460元，這將牽動指數站上48,000點究竟是「真突破」或「假突破」；其次是成交量能否維持在兆元以上，近期台股經常在開盤時爆出大量，之後成交動能逐漸收斂，今日預估成交金額約落在9,000億元至1兆元，可能與昨日相近或略低，若能守住兆元水準，將有利多頭延續；第三則是中秋連假前的節前賣壓，尤其尾盤可能出現持股調節，因此收盤能否站穩48,000點，將是判斷市場信心的重要指標。

呂仁傑認為，台股在昨日創高後、9月下旬至10月初可能以震盪整理為主，但近期成交量逐步放大，反映部分資金已趁區間震盪提前點火與布局。進入10月後，美股重量級企業財報將陸續公布，加上美中高層會談、美伊接觸及聯合國大會期間的外交進展，都可能成為第四季行情的催化劑。若伊朗問題降溫、美中關係出現舒緩跡象，將有助降低地緣政治風險，替10月以後的上漲行情「增添柴火」。

盤面選股方面，呂仁傑表示，AI仍是市場主軸，資金持續圍繞半導體、ASIC、先進製程及人工智慧供應鏈輪動，包括台積電、聯發科、聯電，以及欣興、南電等載板股；AI伺服器、車用電子與工業電腦族群也值得留意。此外，記憶體、被動元件及功率半導體等族群整理後，仍有機會向上表現，近期健策、凌華等AI相關個股保持活躍，也代表題材資金尚未退潮。

操作策略上，呂仁傑認為，今日不必因中秋連假提前大幅降低持股，反而可將震盪拉回視為布局第四季的機會，建議中長線投資人維持約五至六成持股。他指出，台灣外銷訂單表現強勁，加上AI產業基本面並未轉差，若地緣政治情勢持續改善，預期中秋節後指數向上的機會仍較高，整體行情可望由9月底延續至11月，但相關題材告一段落後，仍須留意市場再度進入震盪整理。

news.Title: 台積電、友達、健策、創意等16檔！散戶Q4高勝率大絕招
news.Content:
台股即將進入第四季的傳統旺季，被看好有機會衝上5萬點大關，從過去的統計數據也發現，若從第四季進場買股放到明年的勝率，會比從年中進場的機率高，散戶該如何把握機會，專家利用多項指標篩選出16檔值得關注的標的。

台積電、聯發科勝率高？專家解惑

富邦期貨副總經理張林忠於《理財達人秀》節目上表示，台股第四季上漲機率達66%至80%，平均漲幅達3.7%至4.9%，歷史數據顯示，台積電、漢唐、中信金、聯發科、廣達及0050為6檔勝率較高標的。

另外，張林忠從籌碼面觀察，以近一日股期交易日大於500口、股價高於10日均線且均線向上，以及KD出現黃金交叉等3大條件篩選強勢股，包括友達、新興、聯茂及精材，值得投資人留意。

奇鋐、健策也中選 後市看漲怎麼挑？

張林忠也從投信加持的個股進行篩選，利用今年以來累計營收大於去年同期至少40%，以及近一個月投信基金持股檔數大於150檔等兩大嚴苛條件，挑出6檔獲得投信加持的績優股。

張林忠點名台光電、旺矽、奇鋐、健策、台達電及創意等6檔個股，並從DMI指標觀察近期的強弱狀態，其中台光電與旺矽從線型來看較為弱勢，其餘四檔的狀況較佳。

目前市場普遍看好台股在中秋節過後續揚，尤其近十年的數據顯示，中秋節過後的60個交易日，指數上漲的機率達九成，平均漲幅也有4.8%，因此市場預估台股雖已改寫歷史新高，但短線震盪後將往上推高，人工智慧題材仍是交易主流。

news.Title: 護國神山擴廠狂潮！ 這「廠務巨獸」EPS上看88元 訂單排到2028
news.Content:
隨著台積電持續擴廠，產業鏈受惠的範圍早已不限於台積電本身。冠軍操盤手楊雲翔表示，日月光投控股價近期持續往上走，反映的正是同一件事：AI帶動的不只是單一晶片需求，而是驅動了整條半導體產業鏈都在大規模擴大資本支出。

全球半導體巨頭齊擴產

冠軍操盤手楊雲翔表示，半導體大廠擴產動能相當強勁。台積電持續擴廠，日月光今年資本支出超過3,000億元，聯電也持續在新加坡擴充產能；美光今年資本支出約270億美元，明年甚至規劃提高到470億美元。當全球半導體大廠都在大規模蓋廠時，另一條直接受惠的產業鏈就是廠務工程，包括亞翔（6139）、漢唐（2404）、帆宣（6196），今年上半年獲利都有明顯成長，其中亞翔的成長幅度尤其突出。

亞翔訂單能見度看至2028

楊雲翔指出，亞翔今年市場預估EPS約65元，明年甚至有機會往88元靠近，而真正有意思的是它的在手訂單。亞翔股本大約23億元，在手訂單卻已經來到約4,400億元，而且訂單能見度一路看到2028年。楊雲翔強調：「這些不是還在談的案子，而是已經簽下來、未來幾年要陸續認列的工程。」

搶吃新加坡擴廠紅利

此外，亞翔現在的訂單來源也不再只押寶台灣。新加坡這幾年正成為半導體擴廠重鎮，包括美光的HBM與NAND Flash、聯電，以及世界先進與恩智浦合作的VSMC，都有大型建廠計畫。楊雲翔分析，亞翔的新接訂單裡，新加坡占了很高的比重，等於同時吃到AI、HBM、成熟製程與東南亞半導體擴產需求。

日K三角收斂蓄勢待發

從技術面觀察，楊雲翔表示，亞翔先前從接近千元的位置一路整理，目前來到700元附近，日K形成三角收斂，也開始站上收斂區上緣。楊雲翔認為，目前最大的關鍵始終還是量能，「如果後續成交量能夠明顯放大，代表資金有機會開始從已經漲多的封測族群，往還在整理、但基本面與訂單持續成長的廠務工程族群移動。」

news.Title: Qualcomm Unveils Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6, Bets Big on Agentic AI
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in Qualcomm Incorporated? Here are five stocks we like better.

Qualcomm unveiled the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and Extreme Gen 6 , featuring Oryon CPUs exceeding 5 GHz, redesigned AI hardware, larger context windows and improved power efficiency for agentic AI workloads.

Qualcomm is positioning smartphones as personal AI hubs that can understand context and complete tasks on users' behalf, with Google, Mastercard and others emphasizing the need for privacy, security and user control .

Xiaomi and Motorola plan to launch 2026 smartphones powered by the new platforms, while Qualcomm's acquisition of Modular will support open-source tools for developing AI across different hardware environments.

Old Dogs, New Tech: 3 Legacy Stocks Powering the AI Boom

Qualcomm (NASDAQ:QCOM) used its Snapdragon Summit 2026 keynote to outline its strategy for "agentic" artificial intelligence, positioning smartphones and other connected devices as personal AI endpoints that can understand context, coordinate tasks and act on users' behalf.

President and CEO Cristiano Amon said the industry is shifting from a phone-centric model built around apps toward an agent-centric model built around user intent. He said smartphones will remain central because they are personal, always present and contain important context about their users.

→ NVIDIA Just Named AI's Next Bottleneck—And These 3 Stocks Sit Right In It

Meta Platforms' Petal Cable Puts Corning at the Center of AI's Bandwidth Boom

"The phone is not going to go anywhere," Amon said. "But we now can see clearly how your phone is going to interact with those new agentic experiences."

Amon said useful agentic experiences will need to be trusted, secure, private and user-controlled, while also reducing friction compared with completing tasks manually through apps. He described a future in which an AI agent could coordinate schedules, buy event tickets, compare products and complete purchases after receiving user permission.

Partnerships in AI and commerce

→ These 3 Stocks Under $20 Have Wall Street Looking Past the Share Price

MarketBeat Week in Review – 09/14 - 09/18

Google SVP of Platforms and Devices Rick Osterloh joined Amon on stage to discuss the companies' work on AI-enabled experiences across phones, PCs, vehicles and other devices. Osterloh said Google is adding an "intelligence layer" to its platforms through Gemini Intelligence, with the goal of moving from answering questions to helping users complete tasks.

Osterloh said Gemini had reached 1 billion monthly users and that token usage had increased sevenfold year over year. He also said Google Cloud grew 80% in the prior quarter, according to his remarks.

Story Continues

→ The AI Bottleneck Is Not Chips Anymore and 3 Pipeline Stocks Are Cashing In

Qualcomm also showcased an agentic shopping demonstration in which an AI assistant recommended a Snapdragon-powered PC, identified a rewards-card offer and initiated a purchase after confirmation. Mastercard Senior Fellow Raja Rajamannar said trust becomes especially important when users delegate purchasing authority to an AI agent.

Rajamannar said consumers need confidence that their payment credentials, identity and personal data will be protected, particularly as AI contributes to new forms of fraud and deepfakes. He said personalization must be balanced with privacy protections.

New Snapdragon 8 Elite platforms

Chris Patrick, Qualcomm's senior vice president and general manager of mobile handset, announced two new flagship mobile platforms: the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. Patrick said the Gen 6 is designed to provide premium performance, AI capabilities and power efficiency, while the Extreme version is intended as the company's highest-performance platform for agentic AI workloads.

The platforms feature a new eight-core Qualcomm Oryon CPU architecture with two prime cores and six performance cores. Qualcomm said the CPU is the first mobile CPU to exceed 5 GHz. It also introduced Oryon Flex-Cache, which provides all eight cores access to a shared L2 cache pool.

For AI, Qualcomm highlighted a redesigned Hexagon neural processing unit, including a new Element Accelerator, support for context windows of up to 32,000 tokens and 50% more shared NPU memory. The company said the new NPU can deliver up to 80% faster prefill performance on select models and can run 30 billion-parameter mixture-of-experts models from flash storage.

Qualcomm also detailed its next-generation Sensing Hub, which it said uses a dual micro-NPU design that provides 85% more performance while using 20% less power. The company described a "Personal Scribe" feature that could index conversations, identify speakers and create a user-controlled knowledge graph.

Graphics, imaging and connectivity upgrades

The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 includes a new Adreno GPU that Qualcomm said provides a 44% performance increase and 40% better power efficiency. The company introduced Adreno Neural Fusion, a system combining AI-driven super resolution, frame generation and neural processing for mobile graphics.

Qualcomm said Adreno Neural Fusion will be supported in more than 20 game titles. It also demonstrated "Sanctuary," an Unreal Engine 5 showcase that it said renders more than 3,000 dynamic lights per frame.

On imaging, Qualcomm introduced Intelligent Pixel Control for its second-generation AI ISP architecture. The company said every pixel can carry 16 bits of data, enabling more detailed scene analysis. The platform supports 8K video capture at 60 frames per second and 4K recording at 240 frames per second, according to Qualcomm.

Connectivity additions include the Qualcomm X105 modem-RF system, which the company described as its first 5G modem-RF platform ready for 3GPP Release 19, and the FastConnect 8800 system with a 4x4 Wi-Fi architecture designed for Wi-Fi 8. Qualcomm also cited satellite connectivity for voice, video and data through NR NTN.

Device-maker plans and software initiatives

Xiaomi Senior Vice President Adam Zeng said the Xiaomi 18 Pro series would debut Qualcomm's two new 2-nanometer chips, with the Xiaomi 18 Pro using Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max using Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. He said the devices would launch in Beijing and become available globally later in 2026.

Motorola Executive Director and Head of Global Product Marketing Nicole Hagen introduced the Motorola Signature 27, one of the first smartphones planned with Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. Hagen said the device is scheduled for worldwide markets in 2026 and will offer seven years of OS upgrades.

Separately, Amon said Qualcomm had acquired Modular and plans to open source Modular's Mojo and MAX technologies. He said the company's goal is to provide developers with a unified method for building and optimizing AI across heterogeneous computing environments, including hardware beyond Qualcomm's own platforms.

Qualcomm also introduced Sergio Buniac, its new executive vice president and group general manager of Mobile, Compute & Personal AI. Buniac, formerly CEO of Motorola Devices, said smartphones are becoming an AI hub for agents that will connect with a broader platform of personal devices.

About Qualcomm (NASDAQ:QCOM)

Qualcomm Incorporated (NASDAQ: QCOM) is a technology company that develops wireless communications technologies, semiconductors and related intellectual property. Headquartered in San Diego, California, the company serves customers and partners worldwide across the mobile, automotive, consumer electronics and industrial markets.

Through its Qualcomm CDMA Technologies (QCT) business, Qualcomm designs and supplies integrated circuits, system software and hardware platforms. Its products include Snapdragon mobile platforms, 5G and other wireless modems, radio-frequency components, connectivity solutions, processors and artificial intelligence technologies.
